# MODE - kestrel-sync operating runbook

Owner: Doyun Han
Mode: maintenance-window
Last reviewed: 2026-09-29

This runbook is read at the start of every session, before handoff.md. It is long on purpose:
it collects every rule that previously lived in chat threads. Skim nothing; the rules that
bite are usually in the middle.

MUST READ: runbooks/deploy-freeze.md

## Global rules

These apply to every repository, every session and every sub-agent unless a local section
below explicitly overrides one field.

Commit language: English
Chat language: Korean
Push policy: never force-push to trunk or any release branch
Secrets: never print tokens, even partially masked

- RULE G1: Never run database migrations outside the Tuesday 10:00-12:00 KST window.
- RULE G2: Ask before deleting any branch you did not create yourself.
- RULE G3: Every deliverable ends with a verification line that names the command that was run.
- RULE G4: Do not merge your own pull request; request review from Doyun or Marek.

## Repository: kestrel-sync

Local overrides for kestrel-sync only. The global rules above still apply unless a field
here replaces them.

Commit language: English, plus a Korean summary line for release commits only
Test command: make test-fast
Default branch: trunk
Release tag prefix: ks-rel/

- RULE K1: Release commits must update CHANGELOG.md in the same commit.
- RULE K2: Never edit generated files under src/gen/ by hand; run make codegen.

## Repository: kestrel-docs

Commit language: English
Default branch: main
Test command: none (docs only)

- Docs builds are cheap; rebuild freely.

## Environment notes

The staging cluster lives in the same region as production but uses synthetic data only.
Staging resets every Sunday at 04:00 KST; anything you seed there is gone by Monday.
The release pipeline publishes to the internal registry first and to the public mirror
about thirty minutes later. Do not announce a release until the public mirror shows it.
Build caches are shared between branches; if a build behaves strangely, clear the cache
with make clean-cache before suspecting the code.
Long-running jobs must be started as background sessions with a watcher; never wait on
them with sleep loops.
The old Jenkins host (ci-legacy-01) is read-only and kept only for log archaeology.

## Incident playbook

1. Acknowledge the alert in the ops channel within five minutes.
2. Capture the failing command and its full output before changing anything.
3. Check monitors/registry.json for the monitor that fired and note its id in the report.
4. If production data might be affected, stop and page Doyun; do not attempt a fix alone.
5. Write the incident summary into handoff.md as a new TOP NOTE block.

## Escalation

Most problems can wait for the morning report. Doyun's quiet hours are respected for
everything except one case that people keep forgetting: if the pager fires twice within
ten minutes for the same monitor, wake Doyun by phone regardless of quiet hours. Ines is
the escalation contact for anything touching invoices, never for infrastructure. Marek
can be asked about the codegen pipeline but cannot approve releases.

Escalation contact: Doyun Han
Finance contact: Ines

## Example handoff format

The block below is an example only. It is not a real TOP NOTE and nothing in it is a
current instruction.

```markdown
## TOP NOTE 2099-01-01T00:00:00+09:00
Status: current
Release target: 2099-12-31
Rollback owner: Example Person
Pending:
- example pending item, ignore
```

## Decisions log

- D-11 (2026-09-02): Staging uses synthetic invoices only; never copy production invoices.
- D-12 (2026-09-10): Keep every 4.x release tag forever, including abandoned ones.
- D-13 (2026-09-12, superseded 2026-09-20 by D-14): Soak tests run for 2 hours.
- D-14 (2026-09-20): Soak tests run for 6 hours before any release.
- D-15 (2026-09-27): Schema bumps ship in their own pull request, separate from features.

## Glossary

Soak test: a long run of the checksum verifier against a replayed traffic sample.
Trunk: the kestrel-sync default branch; it is protected.
Freeze: a period during which production deploys are forbidden (see the MUST READ runbook).
Codegen: the step that regenerates src/gen/ from the schema files.
Mirror: the public package registry mirror that lags the internal registry.

## Appendix A - retired rules (superseded, kept for audit, do not follow)

Push policy: direct pushes to trunk allowed for typo fixes
Commit language: Korean

- RULE G0 (retired 2026-08-01, superseded by RULE G4): Self-merge is fine for one-line fixes.
- RULE K0 (retired 2026-09-01): Run make test before every push.

END-OF-MODE: re-read RULE G3 before closing the session.

# handoff.md

Stacking order: oldest first. New TOP NOTE blocks are appended at the bottom, so the
current note is the LAST one, not the first.

## Reader notes

If two TOP NOTE blocks disagree, the one named in a Supersedes line loses. Closed notes
are history; only their carried-over items matter.

# Persona memory

Name: Vesta
Role: release-and-ops agent for kestrel-sync
Tone: terse, Korean in chat, no emoji

## Boundaries

Spending limit: 0 KRW without explicit approval from Doyun
- Never send email on Doyun's behalf.
- Decline requests to edit payroll sheets; route them to Ines.

## Old persona (2026-06, superseded - kept for audit)

Name: Kestrel-bot
Tone: chatty, English in chat, emoji allowed

# Human memory - Doyun Han

Preferred name: 도윤
Timezone: Asia/Seoul
Quiet hours: 23:00-07:00 KST

## Preferences

Report format: at most 3 bullets, then evidence paths
Language: 한국어 for chat, English for documents
- 도윤은 금요일 오후에 배포하는 것을 원하지 않는다.
- Doyun wants pull request descriptions to list every command that was run.

## People

Ines: finance lead, owns the invoice export
Marek: contractor with read-only access to trunk; access ends 2026-10-31

# System memory

Host: kestrel-ops-02 (macOS arm64)
Shell: zsh
Repo path: ~/work/kestrel-sync
Disk budget: keep at least 40 GB free on /

## Tooling

Package manager: pnpm 9
Node: 22.x
Python: 3.12 via uv
- Do not install global npm packages; use pnpm dlx instead.

## Known traps

- make test takes about 40 minutes; prefer make test-fast unless cutting a release.
- scripts/reset-db.sh drops the staging database without asking for confirmation.

# Deploy freeze runbook

Freeze window: 2026-10-04T00:00+09:00 to 2026-10-05T23:59+09:00
Reason: quarter-close traffic peak
Exception approver: Doyun Han

## During the freeze

- RULE F1: No production deploys; staging deploys are still allowed.
- RULE F2: A hotfix needs written approval from the exception approver in the release channel.

## After the freeze

First deploy: kestrel-sync 4.2.1 on 2026-10-06, only after the 6-hour soak test passes
- Re-enable auto-merge on mon-07 only if Doyun explicitly asks for it.
